subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Current source proves the direct inbound gap, but preserving simple button-command behavior while exposing full form/select/card data is a product/API shape choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound only
options.body: Split or retitle this work so it only covers direct `interactive` message parsing and leaves action callbacks and merge_forward entirely to their existing linked items.

options.title: Defer full card payloads
options.body: Close or pause broad parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact for the affected channel.
